notes.title: Version 1.3 is out now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33130351/63c83452ac75b5f7af6ed60ac17202de10b4aab1.gif[/img]

[b]Hello everyone![/b] We are happy to announce the new update of [b]Roman The Worm[/b]! We added a lot of new content and fixed a few bugs.

New content:

Shop system added
Emeralds added
Weapons added
Items added
Level timer added
Best times added
New achievements added
Translations added (English, German, Turkish, Russian, Spanish, Polish)
Npcs with dialogue boxes added 
3 boss levels added
The fly enemy is now chasing after you
2 new enemy types with different behaviours added
Cutscenes added
A hidden golden diamond added
New levels added
New graphics added
New music added
New sounds added

Fixed bugs / Small improvements:

Window mode resolution fixed
Smoother jumps
Smooth player movement
Better water movement
Sound bugs fixed
Better movement for the crab enemy

notes.title: Version 1.3 will add Weapons and a Story Campaign!
notes.content:
We are currently working on the biggest Roman The Worm Update yet (Version 1.3). The core gameplay will extend with emerald shards that you will find on your way to buy Powerups and Weapons!

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/771722250229084944/18DCAAAC99D4FAB86B1ABF221D620FCC99F534F6/[/img]

Version 1.3 will also add an actual Story to play through instead of random levels!

We hope you stay tuned for the Update, till then have fun playing.

notes.title: Christmas is near!
notes.content:
In keeping with the season, we released a small update in order to raise the Christmas spirit in Roman The Worm. We hope you like it and wish you all a Merry Christmas.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1591958065

notes.title: New graphic update!
notes.content: Today we announce the new graphic update of Roman The Worm. We gave the whole game a new look, replaced every sprite and fixed some little bugs. Also we added alot more detail to creat a better ambience in the game.

notes.title: NEW UPDATE! | 3 new levels and achievements!
notes.content:
The new update has released. Roman The Worm got 3 new levels and achievements to unlock! Also we added a tutorial level and fixed some bugs.

Bugs that were fixed:

- fixed trampoline sprite bug
- fixed trampoline jump height
- enemies don't collide with boxes anymore
- added a mouseover button sound
